svg.title: The Nile Delta calendar, 2000 to 2026
svg.desc: Months down, years across, each month coloured by its hotspot-days (VIIRS-equivalent) in five classes. Before 2012 the values are MODIS converted to VIIRS-equivalent; from 2012 they are measured by VIIRS.
svg.text: Every month of the harmonized record, in hotspot-days (VIIRS-equivalent). Brighter: more fire.
not a whole month of data
Fire data: NASA FIRMS, to 12 November 2026. Classes are the quintiles of the whole record, as in the app's calendar.
